prompt: Put this process into swimlanes: the customer places and pays for the order, the shop validates and ships it.

args.source:
flowchart LR
  place[Place order] --> pay[Pay]
  pay --> validate[Validate order]
  validate --> ship[Ship order]

expect.$expr: (() => { const lane = (re) => v.groups.find((g) => re.test(g.label)).id; const c = lane(/customer/i), s = lane(/shop/i); const p = (id) => v.nodes.find((n) => n.id === id).parentId; return p('place') === c && p('pay') === c && p('validate') === s && p('ship') === s; })()
